name: Motokare no Otouto -Suki ni Nattemo Ii Desu ka?-
original_name: 元彼の弟-好きになってもいいですか？-
source:
Kaoru, whom I had been so in love with back when we were in the college, vanished all of a sudden.
Even after working for a few years in a company, Kaoru’s scent was still vivid to me.

One night, I drank too much and spent the night in a hotel with someone taking care of me.
The next morning, I felt my heart throb when I saw this young man – he looked almost exactly like him…!
Somewhat awkwardly, he laid his hand on mine and whispered,
“May I…?”

The truth came unexpected.
The young man was Kaoru’s brother – totally different personalities, obviously younger, by 7 years; yet they looked almost the same.
When our eyes met, all I could see was a smile very similar to Kaoru’s, and my feelings for him continued to grow.

As my relationship with Kaoru’s brother became closer and closer, "he" appeared in front of me again.

"Hey, haven’t met you in a long time. You look so beautiful now."
At that moment, the person who appeared in front of me was none other than Kaoru.

[Edited from the [url=https://koyonplete.com/my-exs-brother-may-i-love-you/]official website[/url]]
